name: self-discover
title: Compose a reasoning plan for the task, then follow it

comparison.purpose: Jev judges which generic reasoning modules suit the task, the model adapts them, turns them into a step-by-step JSON plan, and follows that plan to an answer. LangGraph passes the selection on unchecked. Here a choice state keeps the top MAX_SELECTED_MODULES modules above MODULE_THRESHOLD and ends the run in a failed state, naming the threshold, when no module clears it.
